answers.core: A built in option to mark a node as an editor or debug node would be a convenient feature.
answers.workaround:
Yes.
```gdscript
extends Node

func _ready() -> void:
	if not OS.get_cmdline_args().has("--debug-nodes"):
		print('Removing debug node %s' % get_path())
		queue_free()

```

title: Add an option to mark a node and it's children as editor or debug only
